title: Early-July lull over the Channel approaches — negative case
notes: 1 Jul 2024, chosen as a summer no-deep-low day over the Channel/Biscay approaches. Early July 2024 was cool and changeable in the UK, so this is the WEAKEST negative in the corpus: if ERA5 shows a sub-1005 low in the box the case fails and the review sheet flags it as a case-selection error rather than a detector fault. Bounds narrowed (43-58N, 15W-5E) as for all negatives. Confidence: low-moderate — deliberately kept as an honest stress test.
